lines.en: Kirin invites me in and the two of us proceed to spend the next hour or two laying on her bed, discussing the different bilateral and multilateral trade agreements of Japan.
lines.zh: Kirin 把我请进屋，接下来的一个或两个小时，我们就躺在她的床上，讨论日本各种双边和多边贸易协定。

lines.en: We lie there and talk about life.
The good parts of it, the bad parts of it, and the parts of it that ooze so much mundanity that they may as well not even exist at all.
lines.zh: 聊它好的部分、坏的部分，还有那些平淡无聊到简直可以当作根本不存在的部分。

lines.en: For someone so routinely toxic or manipulative or whatever she's trying to trick herself and everyone else into thinking she is, she certainly has a lot of well-informed opinions on the world.
lines.zh: 对于一个总是表现得有毒、会操控人心——或者说，一个拼命想让自己和所有人都相信她就是那种人的人来说，她对这个世界倒是有不少见地深刻的看法。

lines.en: But I guess something like that is easy when the world is such a terrible, worthless place.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，当这个世界糟糕透顶、一文不值的时候，做到这一点大概也不难。

lines.en: Sometimes, I feel like the two of us wish we could destroy the world and just float around in the ether until we suffocate and die from lack of oxygen.
lines.zh: 有时候我觉得，我们两个都想毁掉这个世界，然后在以太里飘着，直到缺氧窒息而死。

lines.en: But then again, it could just be me.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，也可能只有我这么想。

lines.en: So I shall continue to dream of a world without anything-
lines.zh: 所以我会继续梦见一个空无一物的世界——

lines.en: And Kirin will continue to suffocate in her own, special ways.
lines.zh: 而 Kirin 会继续用她自己独特的方式窒息。

lines.en: One [[non-sexual] thing that happens when two people lie in bed for X amount of time is that one of them normally grows tired.
lines.zh: 两个人躺在床上待上 X 那么久，会发生一件[[与性无关的]的事：其中一个通常会开始犯困。

lines.en: Not tired of the same mundanity I mentioned previously, but tired in general.
lines.zh: 不是厌倦了我前面提到的那种平淡，而是单纯的困了。

lines.en: The conversation carries on until she can no longer keep her eyes open.
lines.zh: 对话一直持续到她再也睁不开眼睛。

lines.en: She trails off in the middle of a discussion and passes out.
lines.zh: 她话说到一半就没了声，昏睡过去。

lines.en: I think about waking her up to sate my boredom but ultimately decide against it, pulling her blanket over her and turning the lights off as I head back home.
lines.zh: 我想过把她叫醒好解我的闷，最终还是作罢，替她盖上毯子、关上灯，然后回家。
